title: self-improve shared definitions
description: Shared $defs referenced by the other schemas (config.json is self-contained). Fields marked x-untrusted carry retro, model or file text.

proposal_id.description: sp- plus 8 lowercase base32 characters (a prefix of at least 4 is accepted on input only).

candidate_id.description: c1 to c20, unique only inside its retro.

label.description: One k=v label (guide section 9 multiset form; notice-route reads it).

labels.description: An array of k=v strings, never an object.

revision_error.description: The last failed edit run; the proposal itself is unchanged by it.

plan_tier.description: A refused target never gets a plan.

reason.description: Closed reason of a failed, refused or rejected proposal.

output_warning.description: A proposal warning or a command-level warning.

summary.description: Numbers and a path from the user's own config or flag; no model, retro or file text.

replacement.description: One exact find/replace pair against the staged target text. old is non-empty; uniqueness and old != new are tool-enforced.

items.description: A cited finding copied from retro show at row creation; a finding the retro did not have is stored with null title and detail.

candidate_snapshot.description: The retro candidate as stored on the proposal; the text fields are untrusted, risk and sessions are tool-written.

target.description: sha256 and size are null unless the target was read (a refused row whose refusal came before the read); non-null for ready, applied and undone.

refusal.description: Why a refused row was refused; plugin, version and source are null unless plugin_cache.

dry_run_propose.description: --dry-run of propose, resolve and edit: what would be drafted; nothing is written.

plan.description: The fields hashed into plan_sha256 (canonical JSON, see the interface). edit_sha256 is null for undo.

revision.description: The run number that produced the stored edit.

diff.description: Rendered unified diff (ASCII-escaped); only with show --diff.

proposal.description: The Proposal object. Fields marked x-untrusted carry retro or model text.

row.description: One row of list: no model text and no session id.

message.description: A fixed string of the tool; never retro, model or file text.

field.description: The config key, flag or variable at fault, never its value.

details.description: Closed set of ids, counts and enums; never a path of a transcript, a value or model text.

error.description: Exit mapping: 1 internal, 2 usage or config_invalid, 10 not_found, 11 vetoed, 12 failed, 13 needs_human, 14-18 session_ended, 20 refused, 21 ambiguous, 22 nothing_to_do.
